name: my-finances
description: Finanças em casal — dashboard com CRUD, light/dark mode e backend leve

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it my-finances-db psql -U finances -d finances
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
